observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Outdoors under a large white tent on a wooden stage, with an audience seated nearby and a scenic backdrop depicting water.
observation.dancers: A group of mixed adult men and women, paired as couples.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples arranged in a circle, moving in a counterclockwise wheel formation and breaking into closed ballroom holds.
observation.posture: Upright and erect torso, soft knees with weight transferred rhythmically on the beat.
observation.footwork: Bouncing stepping pattern on the balls of the feet with quick weight changes aligned with the upbeat rhythm.
observation.arms_and_hands: Partners holding hands at shoulder height outstretched in a circle, transitioning into closed ballroom dance holds.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively upright and stable while shifting weight during turns and steps.
observation.partnering: Couples dancing together with hand-in-hand connections and closed ballroom embraces.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Low-level continuous stepping with spinning turns executed by couples.
observation.costume_and_props: Traditional folk attire including vests, white shirts, breeches, and stockings for men; long skirts, aprons, blouses, and headpieces or braids for women.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot placement and fast weight transfer cannot be determined precisely due to video compression and sample rate.

signature_moments.what: Couples spin in a fast closed-hold circle while maintaining bouncy steps.
